assets.caption: Training-time fusion teacher. Frozen DINOv3 descriptors are adapted and fused with point-aligned features at four stages; separate auxiliary and main classifiers provide teacher predictions.
assets.notes: Architecture schematic, not experimental output. Images and fusion teacher are used during training.

assets.caption: LiDAR-only semantic mapping. The frozen student supplies point labels for PIN-SLAM map learning, while point-to-implicit registration estimates poses geometrically. A separate semantic decoder reads the learned neural-point map.
assets.notes: Current native semantic MLP route. No direct semantic tracking residual is shown or claimed.
assets.conversion: Unmodified SVG copy; no crop, redraw or scientific-content change.

assets.caption: LiDAR student architecture with four point–voxel stages, point-aligned stage features, a main 19-class classifier, and training-only auxiliary heads.
assets.notes: Local student architecture, not a reproduction of the official 2DPASS architecture. Source README confirms correspondence to integrated student.py/voxelizer.py.

assets.notes: Mixed train/validation qualitative gallery; not an independent test set. Student corresponds to scratch validation mIoU 40.817739% and accuracy 86.001237% over frames 400–499.
